title: perf(gc): probe bd context once per TTL instead of once per store open (cr-uavzft)
body:
Every gc CLI call opens several stores, and each open ran the beads storage
preflight, which unconditionally forked 'bd <scope> context --json' to ask what
backend the process was about to open (cr-m3g3od measured 4 children for one
'gc bd show'). The answer - backend, dolt_mode, bd_version, schema_version - is
process-static inside any window the call lives in, so read it once per
(city, scope) and reuse it.

Only a success is recorded and the entry is aged by a TTL, so a bd that is
unreachable, uninstalled, or mid-upgrade still fails the preflight closed on
every later check, and a long-lived controller re-probes instead of carrying a
boot-time answer forever. The per-entry mutex is held across the probe, so
concurrent opens of one scope collapse into a single spawn.

Same shape gc already uses for the city-scoped storage routes
(cli_storage_routes.go), and consistent with its position on this probe in a
poll path (api_state_conditional_writes.go: 'a status poll must not shell out
to bd').

Bead: cr-uavzft
(cherry picked from commit 4d18e29d55adb25a4e6a4ee03e4d5a1b6841d198)

Staged and tested in the westlands estate (bead cr-uavzft); tests green on the estate builders.
